name: red-discordbot
description: The newest Red-Discordbot in a convenient multi-arch container. How to create a bot account: https://discordpy.readthedocs.io/en/v1.0.1/discord.html#creating-a-bot-account More variables for Red-DiscordBot can be found in the readme: https://github.com/PhasecoreX/docker-red-discordbot

paths.name: Data
paths.description: Red-DiscordBot data will be stored here.

variables.name: Token
variables.description: The bot token you want Red-DiscordBot to use.

variables.name: Prefix
variables.description: The prefix you want Red-DiscordBot to use for commands.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID to run the container as.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID to run the container as.
